row.evidence: Airwallex's 'Set up SSO with Okta' guide lists SCIM provisioning as 'No - Planned for a future release; not part of this integration', and JIT provisioning as 'No'.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM on any plan: the Okta OIDC SSO app (OIN, Aug 2026) is sign-in only, with no JIT; users must be invited in Settings > User Management or imported by the HRIS integration (daily sync that can auto-remove offboarded users). Plans (US, monthly prices): Explore free (up to 10 Spend users), Grow $12 per Spend user/month plus a platform fee, Accelerate custom. SSO is Accelerate, or Grow in the US and Canada per the help centre; the US pricing page still says SSO is coming soon. Single IdP per organisation; Okta is the only documented IdP. Public API has a security audit log endpoint but no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Explore
plans.price_text: Free, $0 per user/month (up to 10 free Spend users)

plans.name: Grow
plans.price_text: $12 per user/month + platform fee based on team size (max 250 Spend users)
plans.notes: SSO on Grow applies in the US and Canada per the help centre; the US pricing page still says 'Single sign-on COMING SOON' (see conflicts). 'User' = active Spend user (cardholder or expense/bill submitter/approver).

scim.notes: The Okta SSO guide's supported-features table lists 'SCIM provisioning: No - Planned for a future release; not part of this integration.' JIT provisioning is also 'No'.

capabilities.notes: The public API reference (payments, payouts, issuing cardholders, billing, connected accounts, security audit log) has no organisation user-management endpoints; false is by absence.

endpoints.purpose: List security audit logs (user management, logins, API keys, 2FA, credential changes)

okta.notes: OIN app (OIDC only checked, updated Aug 12 2026). SP-initiated only; no SCIM, no JIT.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial (airwallex-tutorial 404); help centre says other IdPs need the account manager.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integration: daily import of users to invite, field sync, optional automatic removal of offboarded users (cards cancelled)
